definition: Projecting activations onto their directions of greatest variance, and across 6 sources the baseline that decomposition methods must beat and frequently do not by much. Two careful comparisons. On automated interpretability across residual-stream layers, sparse coding scores about 0.30 at the first layer declining to 0.15 by the fifth, against 0.07 to 0.13 for principal components and 0.06 to 0.08 for random directions -- so the ordering is right and the margin narrows with depth. On causal transport, ablating the top-j modes of an alternative decomposition moves a behavioural readout more than j random directions and less than j principal directions (at j=8, principal components remove 60 percent against the modes' 25), with the gap decaying 4.1-fold in depth-distance and essentially gone by about 8 -- read by those authors narrowly, as principal components ceasing to be the better transport basis without the alternative being shown to be one. The archive's use of this pair is as a template: report the simple baseline and the random null together, and let the margin between them bound the claim.

evidence.note: Builds a parallel entity grid of 27 folk-narrative motifs across 10 cultures and instruments 18 models with probing, logit lens, activation patching and generation, finding that the residual stream separates cultures cleanly in every model while the readout collapses onto Greco-Roman defaults — so the failure is at the decoder, not the encoder.
evidence.title: Cultural Awareness is Represented but Not Decoded: Tracing Mythological Knowledge across 18 Open-Source LLMs

evidence.note: Compares linear probes against RFM-derived concept vectors for reading how much a sentence concerns a concept out of a frozen LLM's activations, on a human-annotated ESG benchmark, and finds the simpler probe consistently stronger.
evidence.title: Measuring Concept Content in Text from LLM Activations: ESG Evidence from Concept Vectors and Linear Probes

evidence.note: Shows that which layers a steering vector should be injected at is a property of the individual input rather than of the task, that a greedy per-input rule reaches the exhaustive optimum for structural reasons, and that a label-free predictor trained to imitate that rule recovers most of the oracle at deployment.
evidence.title: Deployable Per-Instance Multi-Layer Activation Steering for Large Language Models

evidence.note: Treats a transformer forward pass as a controlled dynamical system with depth as time, lifts it with the Koopman operator to get a finite linear realisation whose spectrum is coordinate-free, proves that spectrum is recoverable from finite calibration data at the parametric rate, and then proves that the identifiable object and the human-legible object cannot be the same object.
evidence.title: Intrinsic Structure: Spectral Identifiability for Mechanistic Interpretability

evidence.note: Trains sparse autoencoders on language model activations to recover an overcomplete dictionary of sparsely activating directions, and shows those directions are more interpretable and more precisely causal than neurons, PCA or ICA.
evidence.title: Sparse Autoencoders Find Highly Interpretable Features in Language Models

evidence.note: Activations taken just before each explicit "Step k:" marker occupy linearly separable, step-indexed regions of representation space, and how a chain moves between those regions late in the trace predicts whether the final answer will be correct, which is used to gate interventions and to steer reasoning length.
evidence.title: LLM Reasoning as Trajectories: Step-Specific Representation Geometry and Correctness Signals

name: PCA
